name: subagents-stacked
title: A stacked kitten starts only after the one before it, from its branch
about: The agent starts Kitten 1 (a copy of its own, working a few seconds) and Kitten 2 with after 1. Kitten 2's card says After Kitten 1 and Queued while Kitten 1 works; it starts only when Kitten 1 is done, in a copy made from Kitten 1's branch (it reads Kitten 1's file), and its branch has Kitten 1's commit as an ancestor.

steps.text:
Do these in order [fake:delegate] mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"First","prompt":"[fake:steps]
write a.txt one
sh git add -A && git -c user.name=Kit -c user.email=kit@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm work
stay 4","placement":"own_copy"} ; mcp neko start_subagent {"title":"Second","prompt":"[fake:steps]
sh cat a.txt
write b.txt two
sh git add -A && git -c user.name=Kit -c user.email=kit@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -qm work","placement":"own_copy","after":"1"}

steps.expect: The second card says it follows Kitten 1 and waits, while the first works
Both finish, one after the other, and wake the thread

sh.run: A=$(git -C files/acme-api for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' 'refs/heads/neko/*-1'); B=$(git -C files/acme-api for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' 'refs/heads/neko/*-2'); git -C files/acme-api merge-base --is-ancestor $A $B && echo yes
git -C files/acme-api ls-tree -r --name-only "$(git -C files/acme-api for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' 'refs/heads/neko/*-2')" | tr '\n' ' '

steps.expect: The second kitten's branch holds the first's work: it started from that branch and read its file
